messages:
ellie_cs: FYI incoming from Greenforge procurement. They want to shorten the renewal from 12 -> 9 months, move billing to quarterly invoices, and add a one-time onboarding credit. They also want the signature on the amendment to be via e-sign and the PO to reference the new legal (Greenforge UK Ltd). Can we do all that?
arjun_sales: Shortening term ok if we keep pro-rata economics. Need to confirm discount impact; they asked for 10% off list for the shortened term. Who owns pricing approval?
tess_billing: Quarterly billing is fine. For UK legal we need VAT reg number and preferred invoice remit address. Also if they move to quarterly we need to recalc payment schedule and update AR terms to net45 (their procurement asked for net45).
hannah_legal: E-sign OK; no wet signature required. But they changed legal entity name - we need signed attestation that the signature is from authorized signatory for Greenforge UK Ltd. Also if they want a shorter term we should add rollover clause: "no automatic renewal - explicit renewal required."
ellie_cs: Customer says credit = $3,000 onboarding credit applied against first invoice, and effective change date = 2024-04-01. They want quarterly invoices starting 2024-04-01. Can Billing produce a sample invoice schedule?
tess_billing: I'll run numbers. Need confirmed MRR or seat count + annual list to compute quarterly instalments. Also confirm whether credit applies to first invoice or spread across first two.
arjun_sales: Seats = 40, list = $900/seat/yr. They want the credit applied to first invoice only. Approving 10% off for 9-month term requires manager sign-off; I'll ping my manager now.
hannah_legal: Draft amendment checklist: (1) party names updated to Greenforge UK Ltd (include company reg no), (2) term change clause with explicit end date 2025-01-31, (3) billing cadence = quarterly, (4) onboarding credit clause, (5) signature block and e-sign attestation. I can produce a short attestation line: "Signer attests authority to bind Greenforge UK Ltd."
docu_sign_bot: DocuSign envelope prepped (env: gf-2024-amd-09)  set to standard e-sign flow. Will switch to manual upload if customer requests otherwise.
ellie_cs: Thanks. Manager approved 10% off for this renewal. Arjun, please confirm price calc and send to Billing.
arjun_sales: Price calc: 40 seats * $900 = $36,000/yr. For 9 months = $27,000 pre-discount. 10% off -> $24,300. Quarterly invoices = 3 payments of $8,100, apply $3,000 credit to first invoice -> first invoice $5,100, then two invoices $8,100 each. Confirm?
tess_billing: Confirmed math. I'll generate invoice templates and a PDF schedule. Need VAT ID and PO number to populate. If PO references old name, finance will request corrected PO before issuing.
ellie_cs: I'll ask Procurement to send updated PO with VAT + confirm signatory email for DocuSign. Target dates: draft amendment to customer by 2024-03-05, signed by 2024-03-10, invoices issued 2024-04-01. Any blockers?
hannah_legal: No blockers from Legal as long as attestation and company reg are provided.
arjun_sales: Manager added note: approve discount provided no expansion credits stacked within 90 days. I'll add to amendment.
tess_billing: FYI payment term net45 is longer than standard; this will affect cash schedule. Finance ok but mark as exception.
docu_sign_bot: Status: envelope gf-2024-amd-09 queued. Signers: 1) Greenforge signer (email pending), 2) Redwood signer (auto).
ellie_cs: Great. I'll follow up with customer for PO + signatory and post updates here. :handshake:
